info.description: The REST API that PostgREST serves for the public schema, as the role authenticated sees it: the report and analytics functions under /rpc and the tables and views. Every call needs the publishable key and a signed-in session; row-level security limits each member to its tenant and stores. docs/api.md is the full reference, with the roles, the security model and examples.

rowFilter.item_category_overrides.item_t.name: item_type_external_id

rowFilter.item_costs.store_id.description: null applies the cost to every store of the tenant
rowFilter.item_costs.store_id.name: store_id

rowFilter.notification_channels.address_.name: address_hint

rowFilter.notification_channels.muted_ru.name: muted_rules

rowFilter.notification_channels.timezone.name: timezone

rowFilter.outbound_messages.recipient_re.description: opaque reference to the recipient such as a hashed phone or a platform user id, never the raw phone number
rowFilter.outbound_messages.recipient_re.name: recipient_ref

rowFilter.outbound_messages.send_started.name: send_started_at

rowFilter.outbound_messages.sent_at.name: sent_at

rowFilter.shifts.expected_cash_amount.name: expected_cash_amount

rowFilter.stores.business_day_start_minu.name: business_day_start_minutes

rowFilter.stores.opening_hours.description: weekday keys mon..sun, each a list of [open, close] local HH24:MI pairs, for example {"mon": [["07:00", "22:30"]]}
rowFilter.stores.opening_hours.name: opening_hours

rowFilter.stores.sync_resumed_at.description: when the incremental sync last started watching the store again: the store was reactivated or opted back in, or its POS account left paused; the dead-man's switch counts no opening time before it
rowFilter.stores.sync_resumed_at.name: sync_resumed_at

rowFilter.stores.tran_no_reset_period.description: how often the POS restarts its receipt numbering; receipt claims are keyed on store, business date and receipt_no because of it
rowFilter.stores.tran_no_reset_period.name: tran_no_reset_period

rowFilter.strategy_reports.store_id.description: null means the report covers every store of the tenant
rowFilter.strategy_reports.store_id.name: store_id

rowFilter.sync_runs.store_id.description: the one store the run covered (every incremental run, and a window run given a single store); null when the run covered every store it was given
rowFilter.sync_runs.store_id.name: store_id

rowFilter.sync_runs.store_ids.description: the stores a sales run covered: the store of an incremental run, every store given to a window run; null on master-data runs and on runs recorded before this column, which count as covering every store of their account
rowFilter.sync_runs.store_ids.name: store_ids

rowFilter.tenant_members.store_ids.description: null grants access to every store of the tenant
rowFilter.tenant_members.store_ids.name: store_ids

rowFilter.tenants.analytics_inputs_versi.description: incremented by every write to a mapping or rate table that refresh-time aggregates read
rowFilter.tenants.analytics_inputs_versi.name: analytics_inputs_version
